gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
You can count ___ me if you need help.
gaps.explanation: count on somebody = rely on them.

gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: How do you account ___ the sudden change of plan?
gaps.explanation: account for = explain the cause of.

gaps.sentence: Our street was cut ___ for three hours after the storm.
gaps.explanation: cut off = disconnected (power, phone); isolate (a village cut off by snow).

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
